name: Jobab
overview: Jobab was a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Joktan. Beyond this genealogical detail, there is little additional information about his tribe or other attributes. His mention is concise and limited to his lineage as recorded in Genesis 10:29.
namesAndTitles: The name Jobab is a proper name meaning "howler." There is no indication that this name was given by God. The meaning reflects the Hebrew root but no further theological significance is provided in the text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jobab as the son of Joktan, establishing his place within Joktan's lineage. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jobab's significance lies primarily in his role as a descendant of Joktan, situating him within the genealogical framework of Genesis 10. This genealogy traces the descendants of Noah's sons, emphasizing the origins of various peoples. Jobab's mention contributes to the biblical record of early human lineage, underscoring God's providential ordering of history.
